steps.title: Listen, then write — A2 words
body: Same skill as before: hear a word, then build it from letter tiles with only the sound to guide you.
These eight words are a little more varied than A1's — a doubled letter, a mid-word hamza, a borrowed month name spelled the way Arabic hears it. Use 🐢 Slower whenever you need to.

steps.title: Hear the eight words
steps.intro: Listen to each word first and read along. Next you'll spell them with only the sound to go on.

steps.title: Which word was it?
steps.prompt: Listen and choose the word you hear.
steps.explanation: قِصَّة (qiṣṣah) means "story" — the doubled ص is what makes it sound different from a word like مَقَاس.

steps.title: You took eight A2 words from dictation
steps.message: Numbers, a month, and everyday shopping words — all spelled from sound alone. The same skill you'll need to take a note or send a message in Arabic.
